title: Touched by Darkness
description:
The Eclipse has risen. Darkness has swallowed the Empire and is coming for your outpost next! You and your teammates must gather resources, light the arcane beacons, and attempt to survive. But beware! The Shadows that attack your outpost are not the only threat. Darkness may have invaded the mind of a teammate, and you can no longer trust them.
Can you hold this last bastion of humanity together and banish the Eclipse?

In this fantasy-themed Den of Wolves inspired MegaGame you will be members of various locations and factions with specific roles working to reach your goals. Is it to push back the Dark? Possibly...possibly not. Come play and find out.
